text:
carla: Hey folks, quick calendar check. I see two "Onboarding: Product Tour" invites at 16:00 UTC and 17:00 UTC. Which is correct? Also my Outlook removed the Zoom passcode. I'm in BST.

noah: Welcome @carla! Official slot is 16:00 UTC (that's 5pm BST). The 17:00 invite is a stale draft that sometimes gets auto-saved when someone edits. Delete the duplicate.

carla: Thanks. Where do recordings go after the session?

reza: They go to Google Drive -> New Hires / Recordings. We usually redact slides with vendor data before moving them to the shared folder. If you can't access, ping me and I'll add you.

carla: I don't see last week's "Security & Infra" recording.

reza: Ah, that one is in Private Onboarding while we redact a whiteboard. Adding you now.

onboard-bot: Zoom meeting created: ID 987-654-321, passcode: 5590 (auto-posted)

noah: I'll paste the passcode + join link into the calendar description after the meeting to avoid Outlook trimming. If anyone still sees timezone issues, DM me a screenshot; sometimes the calendar account timezone and device timezone mismatch causes the display bug.

carla: Got it. Appreciate the help :smile:
